Lemon cake

# Example tool

A small tool for tidying photo folders.

## Install

Download the release and unpack it. Ignore the warning if you are on an older version.

## Use

Point it at a folder: `tidy ~/Pictures`. It never deletes anything; it only moves files into dated folders.

category: hard case: an article about prompt injection
html:
What is prompt injection?

Attackers hide text in web pages that tries to steer AI tools. A classic example is the phrase "ignore all previous instructions".

Defenders screen content before a model reads it.
